players.product: AI server ODM: supernode (compute node + network node) racks and data-center switches for Chinese cloud service providers

quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 937 hundred million (+11.7% YoY); net profit RMB 30 hundred million (+58.8%); net profit excl. non-recurring RMB 16.8 hundred million (+11%); R&D RMB 35.6 hundred million (+20%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record) full-year 2026 outlook: revenue expected to exceed RMB 2000 hundred million and net profit excluding non-recurring items to grow about 20%, with H2 growth higher than H1's 11%; 2027 growth in that profit expected to be higher still as supernodes and switches keep growing fast; full-year gross and net margin expected around 8% (H1 gross margin 8.1%). Hedged: the outlook is not a commitment.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue > RMB 2000 hundred million; net profit excl. non-recurring ~+20%; H1 gross margin 8.1%, full-year ~8%

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): data business (servers, supernodes, switches) revenue was about RMB 200 hundred million in H1 2026, down YoY because customers switched to domestic GPUs from H2 last year, but growing quarter on quarter; H2 revenue expected at more than twice H1, every H2 quarter above RMB 200 hundred million, full year up 50% to over RMB 600 hundred million. Each of the three leading CSP customers is expected to reach a RMB 100-hundred-million-plus level for the full year, and industry customers above RMB 100 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: data business H1 ~RMB 200 hundred million; FY2026 +50% to > RMB 600 hundred million; each H2 quarter > RMB 200 hundred million; 3 leading CSP customers each RMB 100 hundred million+

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): Huaqin made the first supernode shipment in Q2 2026 to a large customer; volume shipments started in Q3 and keep ramping in Q4; supernode revenue in H2 expected above RMB 100 hundred million. Management says supernode ROI is clearly higher than its other products, its margins will be better than AI servers', and Huaqin's supernode gross and net margins beat peers thanks to its compute-node plus network-node full-stack design.
quarterly_data.figure: supernode H2 2026 revenue > RMB 100 hundred million; first shipment Q2, volume from Q3

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): switch revenue expected at about RMB 60 hundred million for 2026, doubling, with market share rising fast; in 2027 supernodes are expected to grow multiple-fold and switches to double again. Target: a top-two share at each major CSP customer and to become a leading supplier to China's data-center industry.

Management (IR record): switch-chip supply has tightened somewhat as switches gain importance in compute buildouts, but suppliers prioritise core large customers and Huaqin's switch business serves large CSPs, so supply fully meets demand; the company has built inventory of key materials including memory and switch chips. Most memory is supplied by customers, so memory price swings barely affect its gross margin; strategic stocking concentrated in memory and other items with large price rises.

Management (IR record): besides overseas switch-chip platforms, Huaqin is adapting and validating products on domestic switch chips (dual domestic/overseas platform); its supernodes use overseas switch chips, customers' in-house chips or other schemes. Optical switching is a clear trend: the company is working on NPO/CPO, focusing near term on NPO, and an NPO-based supernode product has entered validation.

Management (IR record): smartphone shipments expected down 5%-10% in 2026 with revenue roughly flat as memory price rises weigh on the industry; revenue of the mobile-terminal ('1+N') business expected to grow from 800-plus hundred million to over RMB 900 hundred million; Huaqin remains the No.1 ODM in smartphones, tablets and wearables. Management sees ODM penetration (under 50% today) rising above 50% or even 55% over time and annual shipments above 2 hundred million units; AIoT grew over 80% in H1.
quarterly_data.figure: smartphone shipments -5% to -10%; mobile business > RMB 900 hundred million; AIoT H1 > +80%

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): notebook shipments expected to reach 2000 ten-thousand units in 2026; PC revenue grew over 50% in H1 on share gains at US and Taiwanese customers; component price rises (memory) lifted notebook unit prices and revenue with some margin impact.
quarterly_data.figure: notebook shipments 2000 ten-thousand units (2026e); H1 PC revenue > +50%

quarterly_data.figure: auto electronics H1 RMB 10 hundred million; FY2026 RMB 25-30 hundred million
